generator_note: t25_production_20260930 protocol BASE generator fields (FIXTURE for smoke); records drawn by t25.science.make_data(cfg, seed, theta) with cfg = generator | {namespace, N, m}; calibration pool keyed (namespace, seed), shared across theta; training pool of max(N) records keyed (namespace, seed, theta), smaller N are prefixes

definitions.kron<m>: W = inv(t25.estimate(calibration[:m], C, T)["kron"]) (regularized separable moment estimate, T25)
definitions.full<m>: W = inv(t25.estimate(calibration[:m], C, T)["full"]) (regularized full sample covariance, T25)

task: (seed, theta, N, metric); one JSON record per task

learners.F: t25.science.structured(W, S, t25.science.starts(S, C, T, kc, kt, key), max_iter, tol); full-data key (namespace, seed, theta, N) as T25; CV fold j key (namespace, seed, theta, N, "cv-fold", j)
learners.affine_map: A = t25.map_for(B, W), b = (I - A) mean (fitted mean)

methods.CV: 5-fold CV over {U, F}: folds = methods.folds(N, (namespace, seed, theta, N, "cv-folds"), 5) (same folds for every metric arm and for SHR); score = mean held-out observed weighted residual (x - A x - b)^T W (x - A x - b) in the supplied metric W over all N held-out records; choose the smaller (exact tie -> U); refit the chosen class on all N (= the full-data fit)
methods.RULE: N*-rule: product iff N < N*_pred(theta); N*_pred = None (theta = 0) -> product; the chosen full-data fit
methods.SHR: top-k eigenspace of K_lambda = (1 - lambda) S_w + lambda NKP(S_w), S_w = W^{1/2} S W^{1/2} (whitened centred sample second moment in the supplied metric), NKP = Van Loan-Pitsianis nearest Kronecker product in the T25 vec convention (both factors projected to PSD; nkp.py); basis W^{-1/2} Q as t25.unrestricted; lambda in the grid chosen by the same folds and score (tie -> smallest lambda), refitted on all N. lambda = 0 is bitwise U. lambda = 1 is NOT NFPA (top-k eigenvectors of A_t (x) A_c need not form a k_c x k_t grid): SHR is a third estimator, not an interpolation path between the hard classes. Run only on the all-methods metric arms (W^{1/2} Kronecker).
methods.metric_caveat: For a fixed affine map (A, b) and an independent record x = s + n, E||x - A x - b||_W^2 - E||s - A x - b||_W^2 = tr(W Sigma) - 2 tr(W A Sigma), which depends on the fitted map unless W = Sigma^{-1} (Prop. 2.1, where it equals d - 2k for every rank-k idempotent map). Hence only on the oracle arm do held-out residual differences equal clean-risk differences in expectation; on the estimated arms CV and the SHR lambda selection rank by the W-weighted observed (noisy-target) residual, which is neither the W-clean nor the Sigma^{-1}-clean risk, and their regret combines the data-split cost with this metric mismatch.

nstar.definition: N*_pred = (c_U - c_F)/a - 1, supplement S4.3 first-order crossing (T20-S rows)

scoring: t25.science.risks(A, b, L K L, Sigma, Sigma^{-1})["clean"]: exact expected clean risk in the true Sigma^{-1} metric on an independent record (closed form), for every method and metric arm
regret: per seed and cell: regret(X) = clean risk(X) - min(clean risk(U), clean risk(F)) (descriptive); also reported against the per-cell better class (smaller seed-mean risk)
optimization_limited: full-data F fit flagged if the selected NFPA restart is not stationary or the restart clean-risk spread >= |R_F - R_U| (T25 reduce_records rule); CV fold F fits report non-stationary selected restarts; flagged records are kept, never dropped

inference.interval: approximate simultaneous Bonferroni Student-t over each registered family
inference.zero_SE: a cell whose seed SD is exactly 0 is undecided

R-C1.contrast: per seed: clean risk(N*-rule) - clean risk(CV-select)  (= regret(N*-rule) - regret(CV-select))

R-C2.contrast: per seed: clean risk(SHR(lambda_hat)) - clean risk(better hard class), better hard class = the class (U or F) with the smaller 24-seed mean clean risk in that (theta, N, metric) cell (ties -> U)

reading_notes.R-C1: a cell where CV-select and the N*-rule chose the same class in every seed has contrast exactly 0 (zero SD) and is undecided, i.e. "not larger"; report it as "CV and the rule chose the same class in all seeds" (rows carry zero_SE and cv_choice_F)
reading_notes.R-C2: the better hard class is chosen on the same seeds, which biases the reference low (conservative against SHR); with family size 72 a MET reading means "no cell showed SHR decidedly worse than the better hard class (simultaneous Bonferroni-t over 72 cells)", not "SHR is safe"; marginal unadjusted intervals and the largest positive seed-mean contrast are reported descriptively
reading_notes.full_arms: the N*-rule is not recorded on the full-estimate arms (E1); its choice and regret there are exactly derivable from the recorded U and F clean risks

reading_rule.R-C1: MET iff no R-C1 cell is decided positive (undecided and decided negative both count as "the N*-rule regret is not larger than CV-select regret"); NOT MET otherwise, with the cells listed
reading_rule.R-C2: MET iff no R-C2 cell is decided positive ("safe interpolation"); NOT MET otherwise, with the cells listed
reading_rule.optimization_limited: reported with each reading; deciding cells with optimization-limited records carry a flag

descriptive: per-cell seed-mean clean risk of U, F, CV, RULE, SHR
regret tables (vs per-seed min and vs per-cell better class) for CV, RULE, SHR
CV-select regret on the full-estimate arms
SHR clean risk along the whole lambda path (full-data fits)
